goal: Review the current branch's diff against main like a strict senior engineer and produce an actionable review
rules: Check for: missing tests on changed logic, error handling gaps, N+1 or obvious performance issues, security smells (injection, secrets, unsafe input), and naming that hides intent
Every finding must name the file and line region and say why it matters in one sentence
Separate blockers from nitpicks; do not mix them
End with a verdict: approve, approve with nits, or request changes
